Hi Connor,

Per our contract (MSA §9.4), Acme is preparing to trigger the deployment audit for the pilot private deployment in our staging VPC. Two quick asks before we proceed:

Claire —

Appreciate the heads up and the spreadsheet. Short answers up front:

1) Timeline: we can assemble the operator stewardship package (logs, snapshot checksums, access matrix, and attestation) in 5 business days from the agreed audit start date.
2) Auditor acceptance: we usually accept independent auditors but need a background/contact and scope confirmation. We'll require a non-disclosure addendum and a short security questionnaire from Audit Solutions LLC.

Next steps I propose:
- Can you ask Audit Solutions to send a short intro email and their SOC- or ISO-accreditation details?
- We'll kick legal + ops once we have the auditor details and will confirm the exact console/view ACLs we can provide.

Looping in Marissa (legal) and Hannah (ops) to help with the NDA/addendum and the operational checklist. Marissa — any preferred language we should propose for a limited-access audit rider? Hannah — rough ETA to produce the evidence package once dates are locked?

Connor / Hannah —

Thanks for the loop. I reviewed Acme's proposed categories and sketched a short redline to cover: limited-scope console access, time-boxed evidence delivery, data handling constraints, and an auditor attestation flow. Key points:

- We will accept a named independent auditor pending credential verification and a short addendum (we've attached a draft).
- Access: read-only role, session recording enabled; no ability to export raw token/secret material.
- Evidence delivery: Redwood will provide snapshot checksums, curated KV-cache excerpts (redacted), and operator action logs covering the audit window. Deliverable ETA: 3 business days after audit close for the packaged artifacts; immediate live access during the window.
- Fees: if the audit requires on-site support or an extended window beyond the two business days, we'll need to discuss a short professional-services fee.

I attached: redline-msa-operator-access.docx (draft addendum) and operator-stewardship-checklist.pdf (ops checklist). Hannah — can you confirm the 3-business-day artifacts ETA and whether we have any issues with the proposed read-only ACL?

Marissa Cole

All — quick operational notes from ops POV:

- Read-only console role is straightforward; we'll create a scoped IAM role limited to the staging VPC and restrict export endpoints.
- Session recording and per-session ACL snapshots will be enabled; logs will be immutable for the audit window.
- Artifact package contents (what we'll hand over post-window): checksums (sha256), access matrix CSV, redacted KV excerpts, operator action timeline in CSV, and a one-page attestation signed by our Ops director.
- ETA: I can produce the live access configuration within 2 business days of the auditor confirmation. Post-window artifact packaging: 3 business days as Marissa noted.

Claire / James — please have Audit Solutions send a short email with: accreditation, primary contact, and the requested window dates. Once received, Connor will initiate the addendum + NDA workflows and I will schedule the scoped role creation.
